To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a novel approach to facial expression spotting, that uses a 3D CNN model to spot facial expressions, and that we show that local contrast normalisation is critical for optimal spotting performance.
we propose a deep learning model which uses a local reference frame to improve the spotting of micro and macro expressions in long video sequences.

we present a novel deep learning solution for facial expression spotting, that is based on a 3D CNN model, that compares each frame with two reference frames, that are sampled according to microand macro expression duration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following contributions: 1. We introduce a novel deep learning architecture for spotting facial micro and macro expression, which we call Temporally Oriented Reference Frame (TORF).
the following contributions: • The first deep learning solution to facial expression spotting.
the development and application of deep convolutional neural networks for facial expression spotting.

our method outperforms the current best method by more than 10% in F1 score, on a challenging high frame rate facial expression spotting task.
our method outperforms the state-of-the-art in the domain of micro and macro expression spotting on high frame rate video sequences.
we propose an effective method for spotting expressions in long video sequences, and we show that our method outperforms existing methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel 3D convolutional network for spotting facial expressions on long video sequences, and that we achieve state of the art results for both micro and macro expression spotting.
we propose a new approach for facial expression spotting in video sequences using 3D CNN.
our proposed model outperforms the state of the art methods for spotting both microand macro expressions on the SAMM LV dataset.

the temporal context of a facial expression can be effectively learned from a single frame of video.
deep learning can achieve high performance without optical flow.
